subject: Day 15: growth spurt window open; finalize EPDS this week
bodyText:
Today's focus
Day 15. First growth spurt window is open. Expect 24-48 hours of cluster feeding starting any day this week, then a reset. Avi's milk supply (if breastfeeding) calibrates to demand during this window. Resist the urge to supplement reflexively, but do not ignore signs of insufficient transfer.

Action items
- If Anoushka has not taken the EPDS screen yet, this is the week to do it. A score above 10 warrants a call to her OB; 13 or higher distinguishes likely depression. ACOG on screening for perinatal depression: https://www.acog.org/clinical/clinical-guidance/committee-opinion/articles/2018/11/screening-for-perinatal-depression
- Verify Avi's enrollment on health insurance is processed. Day 30 is the hard deadline. Healthcare.gov reference on QLEs: https://www.healthcare.gov/glossary/qualifying-life-event/
- Open the 529 plan if SSN has arrived. 529 plan overview on Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/529_plan
- Apply for paternity leave if not already on it. California Paid Family Leave: https://edd.ca.gov/en/disability/paid-family-leave/
- Continue feeding log.

Watch-fors
- [low concern] Cluster feeding 24-48 hours during the spurt. Cord stump detached. Baby acne peaking and resolving.
- [low concern] Mother's lochia alba or stopping.
- [monitor] Persistent baby blues in Anoushka. Postpartum Support International: https://www.postpartum.net/
- [call within 24h] Forceful projectile vomiting with weight stagnation (pyloric stenosis presents weeks 3-6). Fewer than six wet diapers per day.
- [call now] Rectal temperature at or above 100.4F (38.0C). Lethargy, refusing all feeds, blue or grey color, breathing faster than 60 per minute at rest, persistent grunting, projectile or bilious-green vomiting. Apnea (pause >20 seconds or with color change). Call 911 for blue lips or unresponsiveness!

Enrichment opportunity
Mirror play during an awake-alert window: hold Avi 30-60 seconds in front of a mirror. He is not recognizing himself yet, but the face-tracking response is the active ingredient.

Upcoming
- Day 15-21: growth spurt likely 24-48 hours of cluster feeding.
- Day 28-35: 1-month well visit window opens; first social smiles begin.
- Day 35-42: peak of the PURPLE crying curve at about 6 weeks.
- Day 42: maternal 6-week postpartum visit.

Further reading
- ACOG on screening for perinatal depression: https://www.acog.org/clinical/clinical-guidance/committee-opinion/articles/2018/11/screening-for-perinatal-depression
- Postpartum Support International: https://www.postpartum.net/
- AAP HealthyChildren first month overview: https://www.healthychildren.org/English/ages-stages/baby/Pages/default.aspx
- 529 plan overview on Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/529_plan
